def get_Inv_Count(arr: list) -> int:
    # 使用 Merge Sort 的思路來計算，時間複雜度 O(n log n)
    def merge_and_count(data):
        if len(data) <= 1:
            return data, 0
        
        mid = len(data) // 2
        left, count_l = merge_and_count(data[:mid])
        right, count_r = merge_and_count(data[mid:])
        
        merged = []
        i = j = 0
        count = count_l + count_r
        
        while i < len(left) and j < len(right):
            if left[i] <= right[j]:
                merged.append(left[i])
                i += 1
            else:
                # 如果左邊比右邊大，代表左邊剩餘的所有元素都與目前右邊元素構成逆序對
                merged.append(right[j])
                count += (len(left) - i)
                j += 1
        
        merged.extend(left[i:])
        merged.extend(right[j:])
        return merged, count

    _, total_count = merge_and_count(arr)
    return total_count

```

    def merge_and_count(data):
        if len(data) <= 1:
            return data, 0
        
        mid = len(data) // 2
        left, count_l = merge_and_count(data[:mid])
        right, count_r = merge_and_count(data[mid:])

        count = count_l + count_r

                i += 1
            else:

                merged.append(right[j])
                count += (len(left) - i)
                j += 1
        
        merged.extend(left[i:])
        merged.extend(right[j:])
